notes: §1985:XV.3.2.4 GR4: ALL PROCEDURES applies GR3 "for every procedure-name in the program, except those appearing within a debugging section". AddAllProceduresSubjects walks the pc space, and a section of no paragraphs had none, so the PERFORM of it and the fall-through into it ran no debugging section. Since kb/Work PB5568 landed the empty section owns a no-op pc wherever a debugging section is compiled and is a subject like every other section. Probed at 85 (ALL PROCEDURES, empty middle section S2): DS S0 START, DS P0 START, P0, DS S2 PERFORM LOOP, AFTER, DS S2 FALL THROUGH, DS S3 FALL THROUGH, DS P3 FALL THROUGH, P3. The witness pb5568_debug_all_procedures_empty_section_85 pins it.

next.reason: 1985: "The ALL PROCEDURES phrase causes the effects described in general rule 3 to occur for every procedure-name in the program"; 2023: "The 2023 USE statement rules (14.9.49) cover only file, exception and report declaratives; none has a FOR DEBUGGING or ALL PROCEDURES phrase.". No candidate covers USE FOR DEBUGGING. The 2023 USE rules address only I-O, exception-condition and report declaratives, so the Debug module's ALL PROCEDURES phrase is dropped.
